Name: cf_select_items
SQL: SELECT coalesce(json_agg("_root"), '[]') AS "_root" FROM (WITH "_root.base" AS (SELECT * FROM "cf_select"."items" WHERE "cf_select"."items"."id" = $1::int4) SELECT row_to_json((SELECT "_e" FROM (SELECT "_root.r.item_tags"."item_tags" AS "item_tags") AS "_e")) AS "_root" FROM "_root.base" LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(json_agg("_root.r.item_tags"), '[]') AS "item_tags" FROM (WITH "_root.r.item_tags.base" AS (SELECT * FROM "cf_select"."item_tags"("item" := ROW("_root.base"."id", "_root.base"."owner_id", "_root.base"."label", "_root.base"."amount", "_root.base"."payload")::"cf_select"."items") AS "_root.r.item_tags.source" WHERE "_root.r.item_tags.source"."id" > $2::int4 AND "_root.r.item_tags.source"."label" = $3::text ORDER BY "id" ASC) SELECT row_to_json((SELECT "_e" FROM (SELECT "_root.r.item_tags.base"."id" AS "id") AS "_e")) AS "_root.r.item_tags" FROM "_root.r.item_tags.base") AS "_root.r.item_tags") AS "_root.r.item_tags" ON ('true')) AS "_root"
